title: Sirih
wikitext:
{{Infobox/Character |location = [[Dragontail]] |abiphone = Yes |minimap_location = dragontail top |location_page_description = Gives the player {{Reputation|Barbarian|10}} for turning them back into a Pigling, and talks about stories they are writing. |x = -699.5 |y = 131 |z = -887.5 }} '''Sirih''' is an [[NPC]] located in {{Zone|Dragontail}}. == Quest == Once '''Sirih''' turns into a [[Pig]], the player can give them {{Item|Sulphur|amount=1}}; this can only be done if the player is a Barbarian. After doing so, the player will be rewarded with {{Reputation|Barbarian|10}}. '''Sirih''' will return to their [[Pig]] form after {{Green|24}} hours. == Dialogue == {| class="wikitable" ! colspan="2" | Condition !Dialogue |- | class="ct" colspan="2" | Interacting while '''Sirih''' is a [[Pig]] |{{Dialogue|&e[NPC] &dSirih&f: Oink.}} |- | class="ct" colspan="2" | Giving [[Sulphur]] for the first time |{{Dialogue| &e[NPC] &dSirih&f: What, when? Oh. &e[NPC] &dSirih&f: How long have I been gone? &e[NPC] &dSirih&f: I keep on forgetting about Sulphur... &e[NPC] &dSirih&f: Nowadays I live as a recluse, focusing on my work. &e[NPC] &dSirih&f: I'm a writer, so I need calm to concentrate on my new novel. &e[NPC] &dSirih&f: I really need to get back to work. }} |- | class="ct" colspan="2" | First Interaction
{{DG|In Barbarian Faction}} |{{Dialogue| &e[NPC] &dSirih&f: The name of my new novel? Hmm... &e[NPC] &dSirih&f: I haven't decided yet. &e[NPC] &dSirih&f: I mostly write fictions. Because you helped me, I'll tell you some of the plot. &e[NPC] &dSirih&f: The story takes place in a dystopian Crimson Isle where the lava of the Volcano is turning into water. &e[NPC] &dSirih&f: We Piglins always dream of water. This book will be about showing that water also brings pain and struggle. }} |- | class="ct" colspan="2" | Giving [[Sulphur|Sulphur]] |{{Dialogue| &e[NPC] &dSirih&f: Again... &e[NPC] &dSirih&f: I get so absorbed by my work... &e[NPC] &dSirih&f: Time really flies when you work on something you love. &e[NPC] &dSirih&f: Thanks for the Sulphur! I'll finish my new novel now. }} |- | class="ct" rowspan="6" colspan="2" | Interacting while '''Sirih''' is {{Red|NOT}} a [[Pig]] |{{Dialogue| &e[NPC] &dSirih&f: My new novel? &e[NPC] &dSirih&f: It's about an old hero that everyone still considers as the strongest. &e[NPC] &dSirih&f: But he himself knows very well that his prime is over and that his next fight will be his last. &e[NPC] &dSirih&f: It's be a sad story about how the expectations of others can force you to do things that hurt you. }} |- |{{Dialogue| &e[NPC] &dSirih&f: My new novel is about someone who has a strange power that allows him to inspect the memories of others. &e[NPC] &dSirih&f: The first part shows him having fun with his powers and exploring ways to use memories to his advantage. &e[NPC] &dSirih&f: But one day he finds a strange character, and in their memories he sees things he should have never seen... &e[NPC] &dSirih&f: That's it! I won't tell you more than that! }} |- |{{Dialogue| &e[NPC] &dSirih&f: I'm currently working on a complex love story. &e[NPC] &dSirih&f: A smart and beautiful girl is forced to marry someone they have never met before. &e[NPC] &dSirih&f: She's apprehensive at first but when she meets him they end up surpassing all expectations. &e[NPC] &dSirih&f: She falls in love quickly but he doesn't and for the first time in her life she has to deal with that emotional pain. &e[NPC] &dSirih&f: It's a simple story but it touches a lot of interesting subjects. }} |- |{{Dialogue| &e[NPC] &dSirih&f: I'm writing a fictional story about Kaeman and his wife Sarah, before the Calamity. &e[NPC] &dSirih&f: Most people know Kaeman as the Wither King, but I think it's important to remind people that he once was a human. &e[NPC] &dSirih&f: The tragedy of his life isn't very known. He had an idyllic relationship with his wife, up until their daughter was born. &e[NPC] &dSirih&f: I'm trying to show how pain and sorrow turned this well respected man into an evil doer. }} |- |{{Dialogue| &e[NPC] &dSirih&f: My new book is a different take on the battle royale stories. &e[NPC] &dSirih&f: Every 10 years there is a global tournament to the death with all the strongest warriors in the world. &e[NPC] &dSirih&f: The winner of the tournament becomes immortal. &e[NPC] &dSirih&f: Every 250 years there is a special battle royale tournament with the previous 24 winners. &e[NPC] &dSirih&f: The twist is that those battle veterans are accustomed to their immortality, which has impacted their views and personalities over time. &e[NPC] &dSirih&f: It's a bit cheesy, but you gotta make money sometimes. }} |- |{{Dialogue| &e[NPC] &dSirih&f: I think this new story will be my masterpiece. &e[NPC] &dSirih&f: It's a thriller about a genius serial killer who's obsessed with framing police inspectors with his murders. &e[NPC] &dSirih&f: But this time the inspector he framed escaped the justice system and hunts him down. &e[NPC] &dSirih&f: It's an incredible battle of wits between two brilliant minds. }} |- | class="ct" rowspan="5" | [[Abiphones#Contacts|{{Aqua|Abiphone Contact}}]] | class="ct" | Trying to obtain the [[Abiphones#Contacts|{{Aqua|Contact}}]]
while '''Sirih''' is a [[Pig]] |{{Dialogue|&7[&b✆&7] Oink.}} |- | class="ct" | Calling while '''Sirih''' is a [[Pig]] |{{Dialogue|&e[NPC] &dSirih&f: Oink?}} |- | class="ct" rowspan="3" | Calling while '''Sirih''' is {{red|NOT}} a [[Pig]] |{{Dialogue|&e[NPC] &dSirih&f: &b✆ &fI'm pretty busy right now, sorry.}} |- |{{Dialogue|&e[NPC] &dSirih&f: &b✆ &fI know you are worried about me but I'm feeling fine right now. &e[NPC] &dSirih&f: &b✆ &fI need to finish my book.}} |- |{{Dialogue|&e[NPC] &dSirih&f: &b✆ &fIs this urgent? I'm working on my new novel at the moment.}} |} == History == {{History table |ahn= {{History|2022/March 8|link=none|[[File:Sirih.png|26px]] Added '''Sirih'''.}} |beta= {{History|0.13|[[File:Sirih.png|26px]] Added '''Sirih'''.}} {{History|2023/June 21|Changed the [[Abiphone]] interact lying that pig '''Sirih''' doesn't own an [[Abiphone]].}} }} == Navigation == {{Nav/Characters}} {{Nav/Crimson Isle}}
